question_text: Outline how each of ransomware and phishing can lead to a business losing access to its confidential data.
adaptation_rationale: Narrows generic data-loss causes to threats explicitly included in2027 network-vulnerability guidance.
solution: Ransomware encrypts files so authorized users cannot read them without recovery/decryption. Phishing can steal a valid login and let an attacker delete, encrypt or exfiltrate data.

marking_points.criterion: Explains attacker access and resulting data loss.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
